summary: Energy Fuels Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market equity program of up to $500,000,000 of common shares under an existing June 13, 2025 Controlled Equity Offering sales agreement. BMO Capital Markets, Canaccord Genuity and Cantor Fitzgerald serve as lead agents, with B. Riley and H.C. Wainwright as co-agents, paid up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. Reference price was $11.26 on NYSE American and Cdn$15.97 on TSX as of October 6, 2026. No sales are permitted in Canada. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and share overhang.
